section_summary: This section records Japanese notifications under the London and Washington naval treaties about destroyers, submarines, cruisers and an aircraft carrier laid down or completed in 1933–1934. It includes corrections to reported vessel specifications, intelligence on unsuccessful Japanese offers for Argentine submarines, and memoranda on Japanese naval expansion and the powers of the Naval Staff. File notes point to related reports and discussions filed elsewhere.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Hatsushimo keel notification
subfiles.from: William Phillips, for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Acknowledges Japanese particulars for a destroyer whose keel was laid on January 31, 1933.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the treaty notification concerning the destroyer Hatsushimo.

subfiles.title: Correction to Hatsushimo gun calibre
subfiles.about: Reports a Japanese request to correct the largest gun calibre to 12.7 centimetres.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the corrected Hatsushimo gun calibre to the Navy.

subfiles.title: Keel notification for submarine I-70
subfiles.about: Reports the January 25, 1933 laying of I-70's keel and its specifications.
subfiles.summary: Supplies I-70's displacement, dimensions and largest gun calibre under the London Naval Treaty.

subfiles.title: Forwarding I-70 particulars
subfiles.about: Encloses the Japanese Embassy's I-70 notification for Navy Department files.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the I-70 treaty notification.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of I-70 notification
subfiles.from: William Phillips, for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the Japanese note about I-70's keel.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges receipt of I-70 particulars.

subfiles.title: Intelligence on Argentine submarines and Zárate plant
subfiles.about: Reports possible Japanese purchases of three Argentine submarines and a meatpacking plant at Zárate.
subfiles.summary: Naval intelligence says Japan offered 30 percent above cost for three submarines built in Italy for Argentina.

subfiles.title: Intelligence on Argentine submarines and Zárate plant
subfiles.to: J. P. Moffat and E. C. Wilson
subfiles.about: Reports possible Japanese purchases of three Argentine submarines and a meatpacking plant at Zárate.
subfiles.summary: The naval attaché reports a Japanese submarine offer at 30 percent above cost and a recent plant purchase.

subfiles.title: Intelligence on Argentine submarines and Zárate plant
subfiles.about: Repeats intelligence about Japanese interest in Argentine submarines and the Zárate plant.
subfiles.summary: Copy of Ellis's report on the possible submarine sale and plant purchase.

subfiles.title: Keel notification for submarine A-71
subfiles.about: Reports A-71's February 15, 1933 keel laying and technical particulars.
subfiles.summary: Lists A-71's displacement, dimensions and gun calibre.

subfiles.title: Forwarding A-71 particulars
subfiles.about: Encloses the Japanese notification of A-71's keel laying.
subfiles.summary: Forwards A-71 particulars for Navy records.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of A-71 notification
subfiles.about: Acknowledges receipt of the A-71 treaty notification.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the A-71 keel particulars.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to article on naval reductions
subfiles.about: Points to a translation of a Japanese naval officer's article on naval reductions.
subfiles.summary: References a translated article in Diplomatic Review.

subfiles.title: Completion notification for destroyer Hibiki
subfiles.about: Reports Hibiki's completion and requests a correction to submarine A-66's mean draft.
subfiles.summary: Gives Hibiki's construction dates, dimensions and armament. A postscript asks that the reported draft for A-66 be changed, prompting later clarification.

subfiles.title: Forwarding Hibiki completion particulars
subfiles.about: Communicates the Japanese note on Hibiki's completion.
subfiles.summary: Provides Hibiki's construction dates and dimensions to the Navy.

subfiles.title: Reported correction to A-66 draft
subfiles.about: Relays a requested correction to A-66's mean draft.
subfiles.summary: Advises the Navy of the Embassy's draft correction; the figure is subsequently clarified.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Hibiki note and A-66 correction
subfiles.from: William Phillips, for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the Hibiki completion note and its postscript concerning A-66.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges both the destroyer particulars and proposed submarine draft correction.

subfiles.title: Cover letter for Buenos Aires naval attaché report
subfiles.about: Forwards a naval attaché letter concerning Argentine submarines.
subfiles.summary: Davis sends Wilson the Buenos Aires attaché's follow-up report.

subfiles.title: Follow-up on Argentine submarines and Zárate plant
subfiles.about: Reassesses the possible Argentine submarine sale and reports on the Zárate packing plant.
subfiles.summary: New information indicates Argentina intends to keep its submarines, though practical difficulties leave some doubt. The report also discusses the plant's lease and a large corned beef inquiry.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Davis letter
subfiles.about: Thanks Davis for his letter and enclosure.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges receipt of the attaché material.

subfiles.title: Keel notification for Yugure
subfiles.about: Reports Yugure's keel laying and corrects Hatsushimo's largest gun calibre.
subfiles.summary: Lists the destroyer Yugure's April 9, 1933 keel date and specifications. The postscript requests that Hatsushimo's gun calibre be recorded as 12.7 centimetres.

subfiles.title: Forwarding Yugure particulars
subfiles.about: Encloses the Japanese treaty notification for Yugure.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Yugure's keel particulars.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Yugure note
subfiles.from: William Phillips, for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Acknowledges Yugure's particulars and the Hatsushimo gun calibre correction.
subfiles.summary: Confirms receipt of the Yugure note and action on the Hatsushimo correction.

subfiles.title: Clarification of A-66 mean draft
subfiles.about: Clarifies that A-66's correct mean draft is 4.83 metres.
subfiles.summary: Restores the original 4.83 metre figure instead of 4.03 metres.

subfiles.title: Correction of Navy records for A-66
subfiles.about: Advises that A-66's original 4.83 metre draft was correct.
subfiles.summary: Asks the Navy to disregard the intervening 4.03 metre correction.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of A-66 clarification
subfiles.from: William Phillips, for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Confirms that A-66's 4.83 metre mean draft will stand.
subfiles.summary: The Department recognizes the earlier correction request as mistaken, restores 4.83 metres in its records and asks the Navy Department to do the same.

subfiles.title: Cover letter on Japanese offers for Argentine submarines
subfiles.about: Encloses a confidential naval attaché report on Japanese offers for Argentine submarines.
subfiles.summary: Sends the June 16 report to Tokyo for confidential information.

subfiles.title: Argentine rejection of Japanese submarine offers
subfiles.about: Reports that Argentina rejected two Japanese offers for its three submarines.
subfiles.summary: One offer came before completion in Italy; another, shortly before arrival, exceeded total cost by 30 percent. The boats joined the Argentine fleet and are now considered unlikely to be sold.

subfiles.title: Completion notification for aircraft carrier Ryujo
subfiles.about: Reports Ryujo's completion under the Washington Naval Treaty.
subfiles.summary: Gives construction dates and specifications, stating the carrier was an additional vessel rather than a replacement.

subfiles.title: Forwarding Ryujo particulars
subfiles.about: Encloses the Japanese completion notification for Ryujo.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the carrier's particulars for Navy records.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Ryujo notification
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the Japanese note on Ryujo's completion.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the carrier's treaty particulars.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to Japanese naval expansion despatch
subfiles.about: Points to a despatch on a three-year Japanese naval expansion program.
subfiles.summary: References proposed expenditure of 460 million yen.

subfiles.title: Extract on Japanese naval building plans
subfiles.about: Discusses Japanese spending to build to London treaty limits.
subfiles.summary: Describes a three-year construction plan and links it to Japan's anticipated call for revised naval ratios.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to naval construction clipping
subfiles.about: Points to quotations from the Montreal Star on U.S. and Japanese naval construction.
subfiles.summary: References an August 3 newspaper item.

subfiles.title: Unverified report on Japanese naval and commercial plans
subfiles.about: Records an unverified merchant seaman's account of Japanese naval preparations and commercial activity.
subfiles.summary: The report expressly questions its source's reliability. It alleges concealed high-speed vessels, recalled agents, commercial pressure against British goods and metal stockpiling.

subfiles.title: Letter concerning Japanese naval budget
subfiles.about: Calls attention to an enclosed article about Japanese naval spending.
subfiles.summary: A largely illegible correspondent sends a naval budget clipping to the president.

subfiles.title: Tokyo budget for ships
subfiles.about: Reports unusually large Japanese naval budget demands and their perceived causes.
subfiles.summary: The clipping cites ship construction and capital-ship modernization, U.S. naval building, Japan's diplomatic isolation and the coming naval conference.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to Japanese protest over U.S. naval program
subfiles.about: Points to a memorandum and clippings on a Japanese protest over the U.S. naval program.
subfiles.summary: References protest-related materials filed elsewhere.

subfiles.title: Keel notification for submarine B-33
subfiles.about: Reports B-33's August 8, 1933 keel laying and specifications.
subfiles.summary: Provides B-33's displacement, dimensions and gun calibre under the London Naval Treaty.

subfiles.title: Forwarding B-33 particulars
subfiles.about: Encloses the B-33 keel notification.
subfiles.summary: Forwards B-33 particulars to the Navy.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of B-33 notification
subfiles.from: William Phillips, for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the Japanese notification for B-33.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges receipt of the submarine particulars.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to Japanese naval parity report
subfiles.about: Points to a report on Japanese demands for parity or greater relative tonnage in 1935.
subfiles.summary: References Japan's expected naval conference position.

subfiles.title: Chief of Naval Staff to determine Japanese naval strength
subfiles.from: State Department, Division of Far Eastern Affairs
subfiles.about: Analyzes a reported ordinance transferring authority over Japanese naval strength to the Chief of Naval Staff.
subfiles.summary: The memorandum recounts the constitutional dispute surrounding the London Naval Treaty and the removal of Admirals Kato and Suyetsugu. It argues that the new ordinance may strengthen the Big-Navy faction and shape Japan's position at the 1935 conference.

subfiles.title: Forwarding memorandum on Japanese Naval Staff
subfiles.about: Encloses a memorandum on enlarged powers of the Japanese Chief of Naval Staff.
subfiles.summary: Sends the Naval Staff analysis to the Navy.

subfiles.title: Chief of Naval Staff to determine Japanese naval strength
subfiles.from: State Department, Division of Far Eastern Affairs
subfiles.about: Copies the analysis of the Japanese Naval Staff's enlarged powers.
subfiles.summary: This copy recounts the London treaty constitutional dispute and suggests that control over naval strength has shifted from the Minister of Marine to the Chief of Naval Staff, increasing Big-Navy influence before the 1935 conference.

subfiles.title: Chief of Naval Staff to determine Japanese naval strength
subfiles.from: State Department, Division of Far Eastern Affairs
subfiles.about: Copies the analysis of a reported change in Japanese naval decision-making.
subfiles.summary: The memorandum traces the prior treaty dispute and considers how an imperial ordinance could give the Chief of Naval Staff authority over ship numbers and tonnage, affecting Japan's 1935 conference delegation.

subfiles.title: Chief of Naval Staff to determine Japanese naval strength
subfiles.from: State Department, Division of Far Eastern Affairs
subfiles.about: Another copy assesses the Chief of Naval Staff's reported new authority.
subfiles.summary: It argues that shifting authority from the Minister of Marine could entrench the Big-Navy group and reduce the Japanese government's control over naval policy at the next conference.

subfiles.title: Cover letter to Tokyo on Naval Staff ordinance
subfiles.about: Encloses the October 2 memorandum on the Japanese Naval Staff ordinance.
subfiles.summary: Sends the analysis to the ambassador in Tokyo.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to de Martel statement
subfiles.about: Points to a statement by Syria's High Commissioner on future Japanese fleet growth.
subfiles.summary: References de Martel's prediction of expansion after the naval agreements expire.

subfiles.title: Completion notification for Hatsuharu and Nenohi
subfiles.from: T. Taketomi, for the Japanese ambassador
subfiles.about: Reports completion of destroyers Hatsuharu and Nenohi.
subfiles.summary: Both destroyers were completed on September 30, 1933. The note supplies their former numbers, keel dates, displacement, dimensions and armament.

subfiles.title: Forwarding Hatsuharu and Nenohi particulars
subfiles.about: Encloses the Japanese completion notification for Hatsuharu and Nenohi.
subfiles.summary: Forwards both destroyers' particulars to the Navy.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of destroyer completion notification
subfiles.from: R. Walton Moore, for the Acting Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the completion particulars for Hatsuharu and Nenohi.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the Japanese note on the two destroyers.

subfiles.title: Brief note on Hatsuharu and Nenohi
subfiles.about: Records completion and displacement of Hatsuharu and Nenohi.
subfiles.summary: Notes September 30 completion and 1,368 ton displacement.

subfiles.title: Keel notification for Shiratsuyu
subfiles.from: T. Taketomi, Japanese chargé d'affaires ad interim
subfiles.about: Reports Shiratsuyu's November 14, 1933 keel laying and specifications.
subfiles.summary: Supplies the destroyer's displacement, dimensions and gun calibre.

subfiles.title: Forwarding Shiratsuyu particulars
subfiles.about: Encloses the Japanese notification concerning Shiratsuyu.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Shiratsuyu's particulars for Navy files.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Shiratsuyu notification
subfiles.from: R. Walton Moore, for the Acting Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the Shiratsuyu treaty notification.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges receipt of the destroyer particulars.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to Forbes–Hornbeck conversation
subfiles.about: Points to a discussion of naval disarmament and the U.S.–Japan 10:6 ratio.
subfiles.summary: References Forbes and Hornbeck's view that the ratio should remain.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to Japanese acceptance of naval ratio
subfiles.about: Points to comments on whether Japan would continue accepting the 10:6 naval ratio.
subfiles.summary: References a memorandum on Japanese acceptance of the ratio.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to U.S.–British naval differences
subfiles.about: Points to a memorandum urging U.S.–British agreement before approaching Japan on the naval ratio.
subfiles.summary: References differences over naval armaments and the 10:6 ratio.

subfiles.title: Keel notification for Suzuya, Shigure and A-72
subfiles.about: Reports keel laying and specifications for a cruiser, destroyer and submarine.
subfiles.summary: The note gives December 1933 keel dates for Suzuya, Shigure and A-72, with each vessel's displacement, dimensions and largest gun calibre.

subfiles.title: Forwarding Suzuya, Shigure and A-72 particulars
subfiles.about: Encloses the Japanese note concerning Suzuya, Shigure and A-72.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the three vessels' keel particulars.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of three-vessel notification
subfiles.from: William Phillips, for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the notification for Suzuya, Shigure and A-72.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges receipt of particulars for the three vessels.

subfiles.title: Keel notification for Murasame
subfiles.about: Reports Murasame's February 1, 1934 keel laying and specifications.
subfiles.summary: Lists the destroyer's displacement, dimensions and largest gun calibre.

subfiles.title: Forwarding Murasame particulars
subfiles.about: Encloses the Japanese Murasame keel notification.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Murasame's particulars to the Navy.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Murasame notification
subfiles.from: William Phillips, for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the Japanese note on Murasame.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges receipt of Murasame's keel particulars.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to third naval replenishment program
subfiles.about: Points to a report on a proposed third Japanese naval replenishment program.
subfiles.summary: References a program reportedly spurred by U.S. naval plans.

subfiles.title: Keel notification for Kumano and A-73
subfiles.about: Reports April 1934 keel laying for cruiser Kumano and submarine A-73.
subfiles.summary: The note gives Kumano's April 4 and A-73's April 5 keel dates, followed by their displacement, dimensions and gun calibre.
